# Lane 2.97 — Inviting people from the website (handover, 2026-11-23)

Branch `lane/2.97-invitations`. Record 086, T-288 (pending file `docs/specs/v1/decisions-pending/T-288.md`).

## Built

- Admins page `/{league}/admin/settings/admins`: invite by email and role, people with access by name ("No name yet", A-14), open invitations, send again, cancel, remove access, latest changes (activity log). Owner and admin only; everyone else 403.
- Link `/{league}/invitation/{token}` (`route.ts`): holds the token in an HttpOnly cookie for that league's accept page, answers 303 to `/{league}/invitation` with `no-store` and `no-referrer`, logs nothing, same answer for every link.
- Accept page `/{league}/invitation`: `no-store`; one "This link does not work" for every unusable link; visitor is offered sign in / create an account and nothing about the league; after accepting lands on the league's home.
- Core query `access.read_invitation` (test beside it); made-up database sends invitation emails itself (`made-up-invitation-mail.ts`); browser test `tests/browser/admins-invitations-test.mjs` covers the plan's done test.
- 2026-11-23: merged `build/stage-1` (11 conflicts, both sides kept); `tableQueue` back in startup's `DatabasePackage`; `botCheck` in `database-admin-access.test.ts`; `adminAccess` pinned in `database-event-handlers.test.ts`; rows for every kind of person and the link's and accept page's headers, cookie and "no token in the log" in `scripts/check-web-shell.mjs`; the Admins page, accept page and link in `tests/browser/harmful-text-test.mjs` (the invite address box typed into); `kept-emails-test.mjs` follows the link to the token-free page.

## Left (for the lead at landing)

- The plan line's tail: step 2.88's line in `docs/build/STAGE-2.md` gains "Needs: 2.96, 2.97" and the folder `apps/web/src/app` (a plan edit, not made here).
- Fold T-288 into DECISIONS.md; then raise the T4 count in `tests/pending-decisions.test.mjs` from 46 to 47 ("47 since T-288 (step 2.97)").
- Confirm record 086 (written "to be confirmed when the step lands").
- Out of the step, as record 086 says: team roles (coach, captain) and one-program invitations not offered; a refused plain form answers 404, not 403; the stand-in has no invitations (step 2.88).

## Decisions

- T-288, Agreed (delegated), pending: token held in a cookie and forwarded; one answer for every unusable link; the made-up database's invitation emails sent by the web app.
- For the lead to read: the accept page (no token in its address) sends `Referrer-Policy: same-origin`, not `no-referrer`, because under `no-referrer` a browser posts a plain form with `Origin: null` and Next.js refuses it. The token's address sends `no-referrer`. Written in record 086; the shell check pins both.
- No new product decision; no new decision or migration number needed.
